digest.component_or_area: ticket creation seam and event reducer
propositions: REBAR_DETECTED_BY environment variable is read at the ticket creation seam (create_core) and stamps detected_by field on created tickets; --detected-by CLI flag overrides the env value.
Validation normalizes detected_by values by strip() + lowercase; empty or whitespace-only strings are treated as unset (field omitted); unknown tokens are stamped verbatim without enum enforcement.
process_create projects detected_by into compiled state present-only (mirroring source_* blocks); tickets without detected_by reduce byte-identically to the pre-change state, proving additivity.

The optional detected_by field is declared in ticket_state.schema.json and registered in the env-var/docs registry; Jira inbound reconciler intentionally bypasses this logic and produces unattributed tickets.
